units.source: Title

Alongside its content, the __TRILIUM_PH_0__title__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is one of the two main attributes of a __TRILIUM_PH_2__note__TRILIUM_PH_3__. It's the short, human-readable name shown in the editable field at the top of every note, and it's what identifies the note throughout the interface (in the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_5__, in tabs, in the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Breadcrumb__TRILIUM_PH_7__ and win __TRILIUM_PH_8__Internal (reference) links__TRILIUM_PH_9__.
Internally, notes are identified by a unique __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note ID__TRILIUM_PH_1__ rather than by their title, so the title is purely for your benefit. This has a few consequences:
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Titles don't have to be unique.__TRILIUM_PH_1__ You can have any number of notes that share the same title without conflict.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Renaming a note never breaks links to it.__TRILIUM_PH_1__ Links between notes point at the underlying note, so changing a title leaves existing links intact (they'll simply display the new title).
__TRILIUM_PH_0__The title can be left empty.__TRILIUM_PH_1__ Notes with no title display a placeholder (__TRILIUM_PH_2__type note's title here…__TRILIUM_PH_3__) but are otherwise perfectly valid.
In addition:
There is no limitation on the length of the title, however in exports the title might get trimmed.
There are no forbidden symbols, unsupported characters will get trimmed when exporting.
When exporting to a ZIP file, a meta file will contain the full title which will be recognized by Trilium when importing again.
Inline title__TRILIUM_PH_0__

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ notes have a special title bar behavior in which the __TRILIUM_PH_2__note title__TRILIUM_PH_3__ is initially displayed in a larger font, while also displaying additional information such as the creation and the modification date.
Whenever the title is scrolled past, the fixed title is shown instead.
Note types that take the entirety of the screen, such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__Code__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Canvas__TRILIUM_PH_3__, will always have only the fixed title bar.
Under the note title, the __TRILIUM_PH_0__New note type switcher__TRILIUM_PH_1__ appears if the note is empty.

To use the fixed title bar for text notes as well, go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Appearance__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__User Interface__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and set __TRILIUM_PH_6__Note title__TRILIUM_PH_7__ to __TRILIUM_PH_8__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_9__. The title then stays in the fixed title bar and the content starts right below it; the creation and modification dates are not shown. The __TRILIUM_PH_10__New note type switcher__TRILIUM_PH_11__ of an empty note appears at the bottom of the note instead. The setting applies to the current device only.
The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Inline title__TRILIUM_PH_1__, which is displayed at the top of the note and can be scrolled past.
The fixed title bar. The title only appears after scrolling past the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Inline title__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
Editing the title__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Title > Inline title > Editing the title

units.source: To rename a note, simply click into the title field and type. Changes are saved automatically as you type.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Editing the title

units.source: You can also begin editing the title directly from the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__ by selecting a note and pressing __TRILIUM_PH_2__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_3__ (see __TRILIUM_PH_4__Edit note title__TRILIUM_PH_5__ in __TRILIUM_PH_6__Keyboard Shortcuts__TRILIUM_PH_7__), which focuses the title field for the active note.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Editing the title

units.source: Titles may contain any characters, including Unicode and emoji. For security, any HTML in the title is stripped automatically, so the title is always treated as plain text.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Editing the title

units.source: Easily navigating between the title and the content__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Title > Inline title > Easily navigating between the title and the content

units.source: When the cursor is in the title field, pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ moves focus into the note's content. For __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text__TRILIUM_PH_3__ notes this also inserts a fresh empty paragraph at the very top of the document, so you can start writing immediately — much like other note-taking apps.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Easily navigating between the title and the content

units.source: This makes it possible to create a note, type its title, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__, and continue straight into the body without reaching for the mouse.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Easily navigating between the title and the content

units.source: Working with new notes__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Title > Inline title > Working with new notes

units.source: When you create a new note it's given a default title (__TRILIUM_PH_0__new note__TRILIUM_PH_1__) which is pre-selected, so you can type a name right away to replace it. The default title for new notes can be customized per-section — see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Default Note Title__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Working with new notes

units.source: If you decide you don't want the note after all, pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Escape__TRILIUM_PH_1__ while the title of a freshly created note is still focused will discard it.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Working with new notes

units.source: Automatically generated titles__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Title > Inline title > Automatically generated titles

units.source: Some notes get their titles assigned automatically rather than typed:
units.context: Title > Inline title > Automatically generated titles

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Day, week, month and year notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Day Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__ are named from a configurable date pattern.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Automatically generated titles

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Saved Search__TRILIUM_PH_1__ notes are named after the search they perform.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Automatically generated titles

units.source: When a note is duplicated, a suffix is appended to the copy's title to tell it apart from the original.
units.context: Title > Inline title > Automatically generated titles

units.source: Protected notes__TRILIUM_PH_0__

The titles of __TRILIUM_PH_0__Protected Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ are encrypted along with their content. Before entering your password, Trilium cannot decrypt the title: the note tree, the title field, the breadcrumb menus and the tabs label the note __TRILIUM_PH_2__Protected__TRILIUM_PH_3__, and the title cannot be modified.
Once you enter your password and a protected session is active, the real title is decrypted and displayed, and becomes editable again.
